description:
PUBLIC NOTICE
SHERIFF’S SALE
SUPERIOR COURT OF NEW JERSEY
CHANCERY DIVISION,
GLOUCESTER COUNTY
DOCKET NO.: SWC-F-004421-24
SHERIFF’S NO.: 26001299
Plaintiff:
ROMPSEN MORTGAGE LIMITED PARTNERSHIP
Vs
Defendant:
AURA DEVELOPMENT GROUP LLC; AURA INVESTORS, LLC; THIRD STATE INVESTORS, LLC; D.R. HORTON, INC. - NEW JERSEY; AND THE COUNTY OF GLOUCESTER
By virtue of the above stated Writ of Execution to me directed and delivered, issued out of the above stated Court, will be exposed for sale at Public Venue, on Wednesday, November 18, 2026, to-wit, at 2 o’clock in the afternoon prevailing time, at 1 N. Broad Street, Ceremonial Courtroom 201 in the City of Woodbury, County of Gloucester and State of New Jersey, all the following described real estate, that is to say:
Property being known as: RICHWOOD-AURA RD (RTE #667)
ELK TOWNSHIP, NJ 08028
VACANT/UNDEVELOPED LAND and BLOCK: 29 LOTS: 24, 28, 29
PROPERTY IS LOCATED IN ELK TOWNSHIP, GLOUCESTER COUNTY, NEW JERSEY
THIS IS VACANT, UNDEVELOPED LAND
TAX IDENTIFIERS:
BLOCK 29, LOT 29 (KNOWN AS "PROPOSED" BLOCK 29, LOT 24.02 ON PLAT 499, FILED ON AUGUST 31, 2016)
BLOCK 29, LOTS 24.01 & 28 (KNOWN AS "PROPOSED" BLOCK 29, LOT 24.03 ON PLATT 4499, FILED ON AUGUST 31, 2016)
NEAREST CROSS STREET: RICHWOOD-AURA ROAD (A/K/A COUNTY ROUTE #667)
THE PROPERTY BEGINS AT A POINT IN THE WESTERLY LINE OF RICHWOOD-AURA ROAD (A/K/A COUNTY ROUTE #667) 24.75' FROM CENTERLINE.
TOTAL ACERAGE: 81.242 ACRES
UPSET AMOUNT: $9,000,000.00
THIS SUMMARY IS NOT A FULL DESCRIPTION. THE FULL LEGAL DESCRIPTION CAN BE FOUND IN THE OFFICE OF THE GLOUCESTER COUNTY SHERIFF.
The Sheriff hereby reserves the right to adjourn the sale without further notice through publication.
The approximate amount of the Judgment sought to be satisfied by said sale is $29,193,631.90
The purchaser must pay 20% of the purchase price in cash, certified check, cashier’s check, or treasurer’s check, balance to be paid within 30 days.
A deed to be delivered to the purchaser within 30 days from the date of sale, with lawful interest on the balance due, from the 11th day after sale, until the balance is paid.
Any eligible defendant/party interested in purchasing this property through the NJ Community Wealth Preservation Program set forth in NJ A5664 can find more information on our website at https://www.gloucestercountynj.gov/564/Foreclosure-Procedures.
Sales will begin promptly at 2:00pm. Please arrive shortly before this time to check in if you plan on bidding.
SURPLUS MONEY: If after the sale and satisfaction of the mortgage debt, including costs and expenses, there remains any surplus money, the money will be deposited into the Superior Court Trust Fund and any persons claiming the surplus, or any part thereof, may file a motion pursuant to Court Rules 4:64-3 and 4:57-2 stating the nature and extent of that person’s claim and asking for an order directing payment of the surplus money. The Sheriff or other person conducting the sale will have information regarding the surplus, if any.
Seized as the property of the Defendant, and taken in execution at the suit of the Plaintiff, and to be sold by
Carmel M. Morina,
Gloucester County Sheriff
Advertised online at: https://salesweb.civilview.com/Sales/SalesSearch?countyId=19
Date: September 15, 2026
Firm: COLE SCHOTZ P.C.
Judgement Date: 5/15/2026
